author: Thomas_Shoe
body:
Alright, so basically all day Avicus has had two full DTM servers at all time.  In each server there are about 10 spectators spamming /join or "someone leave" in order to get in the game.  If the player count was raised, gameplay would not hurt too much and the chat would be a lot more pleasant.

For example the player count on Senex is 20, I don't think it would hurt to raise it to 30 so more people could play.  
 
I realize the perfect solution would be for all the spectators to go to an open DTM server, but that never seems to happen...Maybe a popup like "Server full, do /hub and find an open match" could help.

What do you guys think?

title: [SUG] Raise The Player Counts

replies.author: resepignev
replies.body:
Moved to server feedback.

And some maps have the player count limit for a reason. If the game is full the map senex is pretty overcrowded and if the limit gets raised up it would be worse.

But the popup message is a pretty good idea!

replies.body: Senex is already crowded as it is, I can only imagine it being at max 12 players but considering the counts and rots we had to edit it for 20... adding 30 would be way too much.

replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
Meh, I loved the days when Senex was a crowded mess. The OP defenses, blocks strewn about, kills galore... it was glorious...

But you make a very fair point though.

@Thomas_Shoe Also, if the player count was raised, then it wouldn't motivate ppl to buy donor which would make the server poorer. Then what would be the point of getting donor?
